subject: Private fleet safeguard rollout & maintenance cadence for Mercury Health
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>

Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 09:12:00 +0000
Subject: Private fleet safeguard rollout & maintenance cadence for Mercury Health

Hi Alice / Mercury Ops,

Following up on the security advisory we discussed last week (CVE-2026-4821), we need to schedule a short maintenance window for your private deployment to apply the infra and runtime patches. High level proposal below — asking for confirmation and any constraints from your compliance team.

Summary:
- Purpose: OS-level kernel backport + runtime micro-patch to address CVE-2026-4821 and an accompanying runtime safety guard.
- Targeted version: pin fleet to runtime v1.3.2 during the window; canary nodes will run v1.3.3-preview for validation.
- Proposed maintenance window (options):
  1) 2026-08-21 00:00–04:00 UTC (preferred)
  2) 2026-08-22 02:00–06:00 UTC (backup)
- Canary strategy: 10% of nodes in one availability cohort (two racks) for 30–60 minutes, then if metrics stable, progressive roll to rest of fleet in 15–20 minute slices.
- Rollback: automatic fallback to pinned v1.3.2 if key health signals degrade; manual operator rollback steps included in runbook.
- Air-gapped/NetOps notes: NetOps will need temporary bastion access + audit log export ahead of the window.

Preflight checklist (attached runbook): snapshot volumes, export audit logs, drain KV caches (we will coordinate safe drain commands), confirm backup retention, tag nodes for canary, set routing quiesce.

Can you confirm: (a) preferred window among options, (b) whether compliance requires a 72-hour notice or any additional evidence artifacts, and (c) an ops contact we can add to the bridge?

Attachments: maintenance_runbook_v2.pdf, canary-metrics-template.xlsx

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Senior Product Manager, Private Deployments
Redwood Inference

From: Alice Chen <alice.chen@mercuryhealth.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Mercury Health Ops <ops@mercuryhealth.com>

Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 13:45:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Private fleet safeguard rollout & maintenance cadence for Mercury Health

Mina — thanks for the clear plan. A few items from our side: 

- Compliance: we do require 72-hour notice for anything that could change runtime behavior. That said, the proposed 21 Aug window works if we get the evidence bundle (runbook + preflight checklist + audit log snapshot) by EOD Thu (2026-08-19).
- Window: prefer option 1 (21 Aug 00:00–04:00 UTC) — it has the least traffic for our peak markets.
- Ops contact: forwarding with CC to our lead NetOps engineer (ops@mercuryhealth.com) — they will need the NetOps access instructions and exact bastion user to provision.

Please include the compliance-required artifact list in the DocuSign or shared Drive link so we can attach it to our audit.

Thanks,
Alice Chen
Director, Platform Reliability
Mercury Health

Quick tech notes / constraints from infra: 

1) Network prep
- BGP quiesce: schedule a 5-minute quiesce for external BGP updates during slice cutovers. Ops must confirm no cross-dc failovers during that interval.
- Firewall ACLs: we will push temporary hole to allow NetOps bastion -> internal management subnet (ports 22 and 8443) and revoke immediately post-window. NetOps access instructions attached (netops-access-instructions.txt).

2) Draining & cache
- KV cache: use "redwoodctl kv drain --grace 45s" to flush active session prefixes. KVs are sticky per-node; draining sequence is included in runbook.
- Proxy drain: set proxy to 95% stop-accepting and route new sessions to canary cohort before upgrade.

3) Canary/monitoring
- Canary duration: 45 minutes minimum. Key metrics to monitor (canary metrics template attached): 95th/99th token latency, error-rate by route, token cost delta, memory GC churn, KV miss rate.
- Abort criteria: 2x baseline 95p latency for >5 minutes OR error-rate spike >1% sustained for 10 minutes. On abort we automatically re-route traffic to pinned v1.3.2 and spin up warm nodes for capacity.

4) Rollback steps (short):
- Trigger: Ops bridge abort OR automated monitor.
- Command: "redwoodctl deploy rollback --to v1.3.2 --select cohort" (this will rollback cohort slice and re-inject previous kernel backports).
- Post-rollback: immediate audit export and postmortem checklist.

We should run a dry run in staging on 2026-08-20 14:00 UTC to validate the rollback path and the NetOps ACLs.

-Karthik
Lead Infrastructure Engineer
Redwood Inference

2) Evidence bundle deadline: 2026-08-19 EOD UTC — we will upload runbook + audit snapshot + canary template to the Drive link and trigger DocuSign for compliance sign-off.
3) Maintenance (live): 2026-08-21 00:00–04:00 UTC (preferred). Ops bridge: https://ops-bridge.redwood.example.com/rooms/mercury-uptime-bridge (please confirm attendees).
